rules.statement: An acknowledgment of a debt, even without an explicit promise to pay, can imply such a promise if the acknowledgment is clear and unconditional.
rules.supporting_quote: "From this contract which is unilateral arises an action to the lender or his heirs against the borrower or his heirs to return a like sum of money or quantity of the thing lent, and of the same quality, and this after the expiration of the time limited by the contract, or if no time has been fixed, then after a reasonable time to be determined by the Judge." (V. d. L. 1.15.2.)
